Looking at this question, I need to recall research on 20S proteasome substrate specificity where a large panel of substrates was systematically tested.

In studies examining the cleavage patterns of the 20S proteasome on multiple substrates, researchers tested a large number of candidate substrates and characterized whether cleavage occurred at the N-terminus, C-terminus, or both termini. From the literature on 20S proteasome substrate processing, approximately 87 substrates were found to undergo cleavage at both the N and C termini, as opposed to being cleaved at only one terminus.

[ANSWER]E[/ANSWER]
